name: The Meridian reserve
description: Blackwater's largest private vault is the target of your most ambitious heist. Assemble three trusted crew members, secure your equipment and choose an escape strategy before the city closes in.

stages.name: Reconnaissance
stages.description: Your crew weighs Selene's briefing against its own judgment. Choose how much preparation to fund before the night begins.

choices.label: Fund thorough preparation
choices.description: Buy greater confidence with a larger planning budget.

choices.label: Trust the crew's instincts
choices.description: Rely on experience and accept a less certain opening.

choices.label: Take the fleeting opportunity
choices.description: Commit while the opening exists, drawing more attention.

stages.name: The approach
stages.description: The crew reaches the reserve's inner world. The city's pressure rises as you choose between patience, confidence and a costly contingency.

choices.label: Choose the patient approach
choices.description: Spend for a quiet approach with less pressure.

choices.label: Rely on the specialist
choices.description: Let your crew's skill carry this uncertain stage.

choices.label: Use the reserved contingency
choices.description: Fund extra support for a steadier approach.

stages.name: The vault
stages.description: The reserve is within reach when a rival crew intervenes. Keep your people together while the vault challenge decides the haul.

choices.label: Deploy the protected reserve
choices.description: Commit your larger support budget to reduce the confrontation's strain.

choices.label: Hold the crew together
choices.description: Rely on discipline under the greatest pressure of the job.

choices.label: Back the specialist's play
choices.description: Spend a measured reserve on your crew's vault challenge.

stages.name: The getaway
stages.description: The haul is in your crew's hands and Blackwater is waking up. Choose the escape strategy that will bring your people home.

choices.label: Ghost route
choices.description: Fund a patient, quiet getaway with less attention.

choices.label: Fast exit under pressure
choices.description: Trust your driver to carry the crew through an intense escape.

choices.label: Decoy convoy contingency
choices.description: Spend your reserve on a prepared escape contingency.
